selected_scope.finding: S1.42AK passed the full-normal LC Office camera/enemy balance gate and is now the accepted gameplay baseline. The first uploaded-session run was aborted after landing before the interior was entered. The second run naturally selected Spooky manor; the user played inside for about three minutes until death and observed no hostile indoor enemy. This is recorded as limited hostile-indoor coverage, not as a spawn regression: ordinary exterior enemy activity, interior/scrap generation and navigation completed without project-critical regression markers. LC Office was not naturally selected in S1.42AK, which the candidate contract explicitly allowed because the completed S1.42AJ-DIAG2 A/B already supplies targeted LC Office generation/elevator/camera coverage.
